correction.reasonTooLong: The reason can be at most {max} characters.

detail.notFoundMessage: This invoice does not exist or you may not have access.

error.alreadyIssued: This order already has an issued invoice.
error.capabilityDisabled: Invoicing is not enabled for this connection.
error.forbidden: You don't have permission to issue invoices - this action requires an administrator account.
error.generic: Could not issue the invoice. Please try again.

failed.retryHint: Rejected - nothing was issued, safe to retry once the cause is fixed.

failureCode.acknowledgement-required: This document needs your decision before it is issued. Read the warning, then issue again and confirm. Nothing was issued.
failureCode.buyer-tax-id-invalid: The provider rejected the buyer’s tax ID. Check the tax ID on the order’s customer, then retry. Nothing was issued.
failureCode.connection-setting-rejected: The provider refused a setting on this connection. Correct it in the connection’s settings, then retry. Nothing was issued.
failureCode.connection-setup-incomplete: This connection is missing a setting it needs to issue invoices. Complete the connection’s settings, then retry. Nothing was issued.
failureCode.invalid-currency: The document’s settlement currency is missing, malformed, or not accepted for this document. Fix the currency on the source order, then retry. Nothing was issued.
failureCode.provider-answer-inconclusive: The provider answered, but its answer does not say whether a document exists there. Check the provider before re-issuing - a blind retry could create a duplicate.
failureCode.provider-error: The provider returned an error. Check the order’s data, then retry. Nothing was issued.
failureCode.provider-rejected: The provider rejected the document. Check the order’s data, then retry. Nothing was issued.
failureCode.sale-classification-required: This connection needs a sale classification (goods vs. services) configured before it can issue invoices. Set it in the connection’s configuration, then retry. Nothing was issued.
failureCode.transport-timeout: The request to the provider timed out, so a document may already exist there. Check the provider before re-issuing - a blind retry could create a duplicate.
failureCode.unknown: We couldn’t confirm whether this invoice was issued. Check the provider before re-issuing - a blind retry could create a duplicate.

inDoubt.causeInconclusive: {connection} answered, but not in a way that says whether the invoice was created.
inDoubt.checkBody: Open the provider portal and verify whether an invoice exists for this order.
inDoubt.confirmBody: Do this only after you've checked {connection}. OpenLinker can't check it for you.
inDoubt.maybe: The invoice may exist there, or it may not.
inDoubt.paused: Retry and switching provider stay off until then, so this sale can't get two invoices.
inDoubt.resolvedBody: Marking as resolved is not available yet.
inDoubt.step1: Look for this order's invoice in {connection}.
inDoubt.step2: Mark it resolved once you know.
inDoubt.title: We can't tell if this invoice was issued

list.title: Invoices

lock.hintFailed: Retrying keeps the same connection, so the numbering series stays continuous.
lock.hintInDoubt: No provider change and no one-click retry while the outcome is unknown.
lock.hintIssued: Issued by {connection}. Every further action on it - correction, resend, email, mark paid - goes to this connection. One sale gets one document, so a receipt cannot be added on top of this invoice.
lock.hintIssuing: An attempt is running and holds this invoice. A second attempt cannot start until it finishes or releases.
lock.hintPending: Already committed to this connection. The document number appears here when the provider responds.
lock.hintStale: This connection is no longer active, so corrections and resends are unavailable here. The invoice itself stands.

explanation.failed: The document could not be attached to the marketplace order.
explanation.no-file: This document has no PDF OpenLinker can send - only a link, or nothing yet. Trying again checks whether a file has appeared since.
explanation.pending: The document is being attached to the marketplace order.
explanation.unsupported: This marketplace does not accept documents through OpenLinker.
explanation.uploaded: The buyer can see this document on the marketplace order.

failure.adapter-unresolved: OpenLinker could not reach the marketplace connection. Check that it is active, then try again.
failure.order-unmapped: OpenLinker does not know this order on the marketplace connection yet.
failure.rejected: The marketplace refused the file, so trying again will not help.
failure.transient: The marketplace did not accept the file this time. Trying again may work.

correction.gridCaption: Invoice lines, in the order they appear on the issued document
correction.gridNote: Enter the quantity and unit price that should be on the invoice - quantity 0 credits the whole line, and a lower price credits the difference without anything being returned. Figures are a preview; your invoicing provider calculates the final amounts on the document.
correction.lineClearedOutOfRange: Line {n} does not exist on this invoice - pick a row below.
correction.linesFetchFailed: Could not load this invoice’s lines. Enter the line number manually, or reopen this form to try again.
correction.linesNotAuthoritative: This invoice’s lines cannot be matched to the stored copy a correction uses - enter the line number from the issued document.
correction.linesUnavailable: Line list unavailable for this invoice - check the line number against the issued document before submitting.

numberingPattern.dailyResetNeeds: Daily reset needs {DD}, {MM} and a year ({YYYY}, {YY} or {FY}) in the pattern, or numbers repeat.
numberingPattern.monthlyResetNeeds: Monthly reset needs {MM} and a year ({YYYY}, {YY} or {FY}) in the pattern, or numbers repeat.
numberingPattern.quarterlyResetNeeds: Quarterly reset needs {QQ} and a year ({YYYY}, {YY} or {FY}) in the pattern, or numbers repeat.
numberingPattern.seqMissing: Add the {seq} variable - a series without a sequence number is not valid.
numberingPattern.yearlyResetNeeds: Yearly reset needs a year ({YYYY}, {YY} or {FY}) in the pattern, or numbers repeat.
